 1. Gp For Land Acquisition
The Court made the following:

ORAL ORDER:
Heard Sri N.Siva Reddy, learned Counsel for the Petitioner and Sri Arjun Chowdary, learned Assistant Government Pleader.

2. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner has submitted on instructions that after submitting the representation under the 1st Proviso of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, even after passage of thirty days they did not submit any application before the competent authority under the 2nd Proviso of Section 64 of the said Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. It transpires from record that the application was submitted to the Collector way back on 06.11.2018 (Ex.P4) and that the Collector did not act on the said representation.
This Court notices that the representation itself had been submitted long time ago and that various Officers would have officiated as Collectors and would have been transferred.

Keeping in mind these aspects, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Respondent No.2 to consider the representation of the Writ Petitioner dated 06.11.2018 within a period of four weeks from the date on which a copy of this order is supplied to him and pass a 'speaking order' within a week thereafter and communicate such order to the Writ Petitioner.
This Court has noticed the inordinate delay in acting on the representation submitted by the Writ Petitioner since the Representation was given on 06.11.2018.
This Court would indicate that any further delay on the part of the Respondent No.2 would be viewed seriously by this Court.

Writ Petitioner is directed to submit a copy of this order along with a photocopy of the Representation dated 06.11.2018 (Ex.P4), if it is available, to the Respondent No.2 within a period of two weeks from today.
If such copy of the Representation is unavailable with the Writ Petitioner, he is at liberty to submit a fresh Representation within two weeks thereafter.
4. With these observations and directions, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No order as to costs.
5. Interlocutory Applications, if any, stand closed in terms of this order.
GANNAMANENIRAMAKRISHNA PRASAD, J Dt:

08.11.2024 Note:Issue C.C. by 11.11.2024.
